operations.description: First cross-namespace aliases: kind=skill, so gen-registry validates the target against .claude/skills/ rather than .claude/agents/. This is the case a bare-name alias map structurally could not express.

Registry rows for the two new skills. Added EXPLICITLY rather than left to gen-registry's auto-add: its agentMapping consistency check runs BEFORE the auto-add and returns 1 when an agent loads an unregistered skill, so the rewrite aborted and every downstream count check cascaded. Measured, not guessed at.
